prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity native Android TV HOME SCREEN design preview, a straight-on 16:9 1920x1080 screenshot filling the entire image. No television bezel, no room, no perspective, no marketing poster. The product is a custom lightweight launcher provisionally named Luma: combine the restrained efficient native app tiles of Rivi, the tasteful depth and subtle glass panels of PLUI, and the useful content recommendations of stock Google TV. This must be a beautiful practical D-pad interface at couch viewing distance. Keep typography crisp, restrained and large enough, clean contemporary humanist sans. Colors: near-black olive charcoal #111713, warm off-white #F4F1E9, subtle muted sage #9FAF9C. Static translucent dark panels with very restrained thin edges, no neon glow, no flashy backgrounds or busy widgets. Selected control has one thin warm ivory rounded focus outline, all other controls remain calm. Only one selected control. Comfortable 5% screen-safe margins. Show real app names in accurate branded rectangular tiles: Netflix, Prime Video, YouTube, Disney+, Apple TV, Max. Use these same fictional sample shows with excellent cinematic poster photography in all previews: Northbound (lonely red train in alpine forest at blue hour), Night Shift (woman investigator in rainy city), Wild Coast (dramatic sunlit ocean cliffs), Orbit (astronaut against planet horizon). These are fictional examples, not the user's viewing history. Include the exact small footer text 'Example shows · Design preview'. Show a clock '8:42 PM' and simple native search/settings line icons, no FPS numbers or performance claims. Render only the actual interface, no explanation text, option letters, design notes, or headings above the screen. Structure and exact labels for this variant follow. Variant CINEMA. A slim left rail with vertically spaced line icons for Home (selected), Apps, Inputs, Settings; brand Luma at the top. A large cinematic feature occupies the upper half of the content area. Its right side shows the train at dusk; a soft dark readability gradient dissolves it toward the left. On left, title 'Northbound', subtitle 'Episode 4 · 26 min left', and a focused ivory-outline button 'Resume'. Do not duplicate the feature as a giant poster card; integrate its image into the background. Immediately beneath, a compact heading 'Your apps' and six medium horizontal branded app tiles in a single strip. Below that a heading 'Continue watching' with four landscape show cards, small provider names, episode details, and thin accurate progress bars. Show the full cards and their labels within the screen. This is immersive but quiet, with all key tasks visible, feature taking roughly 45%, app strip 20%, Continue Watching 25%, breathing room and header making the rest. No weather, no ads, no subscription badges.
